title: 第22章 让她去吧（求追读）
novel_title: 恶毒女配又装纯，禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
【他该不会有系统吧？】和铃在心里问。

    舔狗系统毫不犹豫反驳：【怎么会。系统又不是大白菜，怎么可能夜弦也有。】

    【真的吗？】

    【可是我都有两个系统啊。】

    【额......】舔狗系统也有些动摇了。

    姜暮烟唰地一下拔出紫烟剑拦在和铃身前，横眉冷眼看向走来之人，“夜师弟，我们不欢迎你，还请离开，日后不要再出现在我小师妹眼前！”

    夜弦目光望向和铃，“和铃，我有话要单独和你说。”

    看也没看姜暮烟一眼，十分的傲慢。

    和铃声音冷漠：“我和你没什么说的。”

    同心线起了作用，她现在一点也没感受到系统给的惩罚的痛感。

    夜弦唇角露出一丝笃定的微笑，“你会想和我聊的。”

    和铃翻了个白眼。

    神经病。

    居然这么自信。

    夜弦带着怀念的神色问道：“你还记得玲珑珠吗？”

    玲珑珠？

    和铃回忆了一下，想起来了。

    原身苦恋夜弦而不得，给他送了不少的天材地宝，但夜弦一直对她冷冰冰的，有一年她生辰，喝多了酒，硬从夜弦那里要了一颗红色珠子，当做他给自己的生辰礼物。

    那是原身唯一从夜弦那里得到的东西，向来珍之爱之。

    原身把玲珑珠穿进了碧玉宫铃的挂绳上。

    夜弦忽然提玲珑珠是什么意思？

    难道她的碧玉宫铃在他手中？

    夜弦追上了楼沉月，拿回了她的储物戒吗？

    和铃起身，看向夜弦，“去哪里说话？”

    “阿铃！”

    “小师妹！”
content_en:
[Does he have a system?] He Ling asked in his heart.

The dog-licking system retorted without hesitation: [How could that happen?The system is not a big cabbage, how could Ye Xian also have it?】

【Really?】

[But I have two systems.】

[Um...] The dog-licking system has also been shaken a bit.

Jiang Muyan pulled out the Purple Smoke Sword and stopped in front of He Ling. He looked at the approaching person with a cold eyebrow, "Junior Brother Ye, we don't welcome you. Please leave and don't appear in front of my little junior sister again in the future!"

Ye Xian looked at He Ling and said, "He Ling, I have something to say to you alone."

He didn't even look at Jiang Muyan, he was very arrogant.

He Ling's voice was indifferent: "I have nothing to say to you."

The concentric lines worked, and now she doesn't feel the pain of the punishment given by the system at all.

A determined smile appeared on Ye Xian's lips, "You will want to talk to me."

He Ling rolled his eyes.

Neuropathy.

So confident.

Ye Xian asked with a nostalgic look: "Do you still remember Linglong Pearl?"

Exquisite beads?

He Ling recalled it and remembered it.

The original person fell in love with Yexian but couldn't get it, and gave him a lot of natural and earthly treasures, but Yexian had always been cold to her. One year on her birthday, she drank too much and asked for a red bead from Yexian as a birthday gift to herself.

That was the only thing the original person got from Ye Xian, and he always cherished it.

The original body put the exquisite bead into the lanyard of the jade palace bell.

What does it mean when Ye Xian suddenly mentions Linglong Pearl?

Could it be that her jade palace bell is in his hand?

Did Ye Xian catch up with Lou Chenyue and get her storage ring back?

He Ling stood up and looked at Ye Xian, "Where are we going to talk?"

"A Ling!"

"Little junior sister!"
